title: Port of Iberia Bridge Replacement – David Dubois Road Over Commercial Canal (TV-0030)
intro: A three-stop look at this CPRA project: where it is, what it changes, and its status and funding.

steps.title: Where it's at
steps.body: This project is on David Dubois Road in Iberia Parish, where the road crosses Commercial Canal near the Port of Iberia.

media.alt: Aerial view of David Dubois Road near the Port of Iberia where it crosses Commercial Canal (2024 aerial imagery).

steps.title: What it is changing
steps.body: Like its sister bridge on Port Road, the old timber-and-precast bridge here was wearing out. It was replaced with a new pre-cast concrete bridge able to handle the heavy truck and commuter traffic that keeps the Port of Iberia running, keeping the route safe for years to come.

steps.title: Timeline / Completion Date
steps.body: Project Status: Completed. Estimated Cost: $1,058,013 (about $1.1 million). Funding Source: Coastal Impact Assistance Program (CIAP).
